# Value Tech Solution — AI Automation & Web Development Agency, India

> Value Tech Solution is a remote-first, India-based AI automation studio and web development agency. We ship production-grade AI agents, workflow automations (n8n, GoHighLevel, Zapier, Python), Next.js websites, and SEO programs for startups, agencies, and businesses across India and globally.

Our engineers hold CS degrees and work directly with clients — no juniors handed off after the sales call. Every engagement has a written scope and a fixed price.

---

## Quick facts

- **Founded:** 2024
- **Team:** Senior engineers, computer science graduates
- **Model:** Remote-first, async-friendly (IST / GST / GMT / ET)
- **Billing:** INR (UPI / NEFT / GST invoices) or USD (wire / Stripe)
- **Offices:** India (primary) — clients in UAE, UK, USA, Canada, Singapore, Australia

---

## Core services

### 1. AI Automation & Agent Development
We build production-grade AI agents with evaluation suites, observability, and human-in-the-loop gates.
- Custom AI agents using Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4, Gemini
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and knowledge bases
- Multi-agent orchestration pipelines
- Conversational agents and chatbots for lead capture, support, and ops
- Decision-support analytics and AI dashboards
- Starting from ₹10,000 (approx. $100) · 4–6 weeks

### 2. Workflow Automation
- n8n (open-source, self-hosted; preferred for privacy-sensitive workloads)
- Make.com (visual scenario builder)
- Zapier (no-code, 6,000+ app integrations)
- GoHighLevel / GHL (CRM funnels, WhatsApp automation, client dashboards, agency snapshots)
- Custom Python and Node.js automation services
- Starting from ₹31,900 (approx. $399) for a 2-week diagnostic

### 3. Web Development
- Next.js 15+ (App Router), TypeScript, React
- 95+ Google Lighthouse score guaranteed and enforced in CI
- Headless CMS integration (Sanity, Contentful, Notion)
- SEO-first architecture: schema markup, Core Web Vitals, llms.txt, structured data
- Mobile-first, accessible, edge-runtime ready
- Starter website from ₹41,500 (approx. $500) · 4 weeks

### 4. SEO & Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)
- Technical SEO audits and implementation
- Schema.org markup (FAQPage, LocalBusiness, Service, Article)
- AEO for AI search: Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews
- llms.txt and robots.txt setup for AI crawler visibility
- Content systems and editorial calendars
- SEO retainer from ₹63,900/month (approx. $799/month)

### 5. GoHighLevel (GHL) Agency Work
- White-label GHL setups and agency snapshots
- CRM pipeline automation
- WhatsApp and SMS campaign automation
- Sub-account onboarding and fulfilment workflows

### 6. Claude AI Integration (Anthropic)
- Claude Sonnet / Opus API integration into products
- Prompt engineering, system prompts, guardrails
- Claude-powered RAG systems
- Anthropic Workbench setups for teams
